asset.note: Generated, not obtained: tools/make_test_armature.py --pose-arc=arm_r_raise --thickness=0.030 --frames=33 --fps=16 --arc-start-deg=0 --arc-end-deg=90. Licence-clean by construction; no row in docs/license-map.md because nothing was acquired. Ground truth for every frame is in the .joints.json sidecar beside it.

_notes.what_this_arm_is: B3, the discriminator. The SAME asset as E03-posearc.json - byte-identical GLB, same pinned camera, same channels, same normalisation - with subject.animation switched to `static`. The scene frame stays pinned at 1, so the figure holds the T-pose for all 33 frames and the control does not move.
_notes.why_one_asset_and_not_two: Two GLBs would differ in vertex order, in file bytes, and in anything else the build happened to do differently on the day. One asset and one changed field means B1 and B3 differ in exactly one thing: whether the timeline advances.
_notes.G6_is_NA_here_on_purpose: G6 arms only in per_frame mode. A static subject is CORRECT for this arm, so a gate firing on it would be a gate failing on correct work.
_notes.camera: PINNED, together with the camera TARGET, so this spec and E03-static.json frame the subject identically. `auto` fits the subject's bounding sphere and `bbox_center` derives the aim point, and B1 computes both over the union of all 33 frames while B3 computes them from the bind pose alone. On auto the two arms would differ in framing AND scale as well as in motion, and B3 is the discriminator - it must differ from B1 in exactly one thing. Both numbers are B1's own union fit, measured and written back.
_notes.why_depth_window_is_pinned: PINNED to B1's own measured extent so B1 and B3 share one tonal scale. Per-shot normalisation is computed from each shot's z extent, and the raised arm widens B1's by 11%%: measured, B1 frame 0 and B3 (identical geometry) differed by up to 26 of 255 levels. That is a second difference between the arms and B3 is the discriminator, so it must differ from B1 in exactly one thing. B3's geometry is a subset of B1's, so nothing clips; `measured_within_window` in each manifest records that.
